def: complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in body)

occurrences.text: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
